name: dataviz
description: Charts in the thread: time series, ring charts, top lists (horizontal bars), bars over time buckets, treemaps and Sankey diagrams, with tooltips and SVG/PNG export. Use it when numbers read better as a picture: a trend, a share, a ranking, a breakdown or a flow.

prompts: chart the commits per week on this repo over the last 6 months
show where my disk space goes as a treemap
draw a Sankey of last month's budget: income to spending categories
